reviews.title: Avoid this

It can’t get 120 fps on consoles because you need a display port and the picture quality is ugly and ghosting in 4k. Don’t waste your time and Save your money up to get an actual monitor. Avoid this 👍

reviews.title: Great Large Budget Screen
reviews.comment:
This 27 inch LGLO monitor is a really nice budget monitor choice. Between my teens and myself we have a lot of computers and monitors in our house, for both office and gaming types of use. A lot of nice features such as IPS panel, 2 HDMI connectors, a DisplayPort connector and USB - which I believe is for audio. We don't really use 4k but it's nice that this is an option. The 2k @ 144Hz is certainly a gaming "standard" and this monitor supports it.
Physically it's a small footprint on the stand base, and the monitor itself is quite thin. From my measurements the screen itself is a little over 24 inches wide by a little over 14 inches high.
